faqs.question: How much does flea treatment cost in Jersey City?
faqs.answer: Pricing for flea treatment in Jersey City depends on the size of your property, severity of the infestation, and the treatment method required. Call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote — you get an accurate price on the call.

faqs.question: How long does flea treatment take to work?
faqs.answer: Most customers see a significant reduction in flea activity within 24-48 hours of treatment. Complete elimination typically takes 2-3 weeks as we target fleas at all life stages. We include a follow-up visit to ensure all fleas, larvae, and eggs are eradicated from your Jersey City home.

faqs.question: Is flea treatment safe for my pets and children?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We use EPA-registered products that are safe for pets and children when applied by our trained professionals. We recommend keeping pets and children away from treated areas for 2-4 hours until surfaces are dry, after which your home is completely safe to occupy normally.
